summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and announcement dated June 14–15, 2026, regarding clinical updates presented at the EHA 2026 Congress. The filing discloses data from ongoing trials of olverembatinib and lisaftoclax in hematologic malignancies. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine current report of clinical progress, not a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other corporate transaction. The registrant is the issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, and no deal terms or structural changes are stated.
